title: SecureLogin MC Plugin
description: /login plugin for Minecraft servers. Protect player access and enhance your server's security.
body:
SecureLogin ︱ Premium Authentication & Server Security Solution

Protect your server, secure your staff accounts, and prevent unauthorized access. SecureLogin is a high-performance security and authentication plugin developed by Revers Studio. Built for modern Minecraft networks, this plugin adds an ironclad layer of defense, ensuring that players and administrators must verify their identity before interacting with your world. Stop relying on basic setups and give your server the enterprise-grade protection it deserves.

⚠️ IMPORTANT FOR MODERATORS & USERS:
Please check the visual section below to see real in-game screenshots, config layouts, and live command execution.

❱ KEY FEATURES IN DEPTH:

🛡️ Secure Staff & Player Authentication:
Force users to log in using a secure passphrase or command structure before they can move, break blocks, chat, or execute commands. This completely neutralizes UUID-spoofing and session-stealing attempts.

🔑 Advanced Session Management:
Configurable session timeouts that remember verified players for a specific duration. If a player disconnects and reconnects within the safe window, they won't be forced to re-authenticate, ensuring a seamless quality-of-life experience.

⚙️ Complete Console & Command Logging:
Keep full track of security events. Every login attempt, failed verification, or suspicious activity is registered in detailed logs, allowing administrators to review security breaches instantly.

🚀 High-Performance & Anti-Lag Architecture:
Engineered with efficiency in mind. SecureLogin intercepts packets before they load heavy player data, ensuring that unauthenticated users put zero strain on your server's TPS (Ticks Per Second). It is fully optimized for high-traffic BungeeCord, Velocity, or Spigot/Paper setups.

🎨 100% Customizable Visuals & Locales:
Tailor every single message, title, and action bar to fit your server's style. You can completely brand the authentication messages, countdown timers, and warning alerts via clean configuration files.

Network Stability: Prevents bot attacks from executing malicious commands upon joining.

Revers Studio Quality: Developed under clean coding standards, guaranteeing constant optimization and zero background performance leaks.
